widgets.text: Two families guess the most popular answers to survey questions. The face-off winner can play or pass; three strikes hand the steal to the other family.
Answer quickly in the face-off: the top answer wins control outright.
widgets.title: Tips

widgets.text: Single, double and triple point rounds, then Fast Money: two players give five answers each against the clock; 200 points wins the jackpot.
Points equal the number of surveyed people who gave the answer.
Pick a family name and colour before the game; scores are not saved between sessions.
The first family to 300 points goes to Fast Money.
